test_environment: Node.js with deterministic local @minecraft/server and server-ui test doubles. Not Minecraft.
Cookery_test_scope: Only recipe and guide API modules on the mocked event bus, not whole Cookery/game startup.
rendering_test_scope: Mock records animation/sound/particle invocations and state; No GPU, Bedrock client or network latency. C6 injects documented native-use event payloads only; the engine starting generic item use is NOT simulated.
scenario_note: Family/quality loops are counted as individual test cases, not hundreds of separate engine tests. Includes all12 recipe adapters, all69 input qualities, C2 end-to-end adapters, C3 session/state/transactions, packaged demo and real Cookery API mock-bus coexistence. C6 adds native rideable mocks/all16 stool and all17 light cycles, source-style sonic geometry, cancellation and protection failures. Native seat offsets, Molang interpolation, light emission, food consumption and real chunk persistence are NOT emulated.
